cohort.definition: IMF October 2026 WEO 2026 nominal GDP estimates; not final actuals; aggregates excluded; Taiwan follows IMF separately reported economy convention
cohort.vintage_caveat: The DataMapper API response does not identify a vintage. The user-specified October 2026 cohort and current rank observation are distinguished.

selection_policy: Purposive initial startup/scaleup checkpoint with source-backed South Korean ecosystem connections. Known listed graduates are separately retained; accepted does not certify current private-company or legal status.
rights: Short attributed factual paraphrases only; no copied proprietary datasets, article bodies, contact lists or images. No robots requests, access bypass, credentials, spending, outreach or permission changes.
